ruledOut: Malformed SDK host, path, or autoload query

security.securityHeaders: X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and X-Frame-Options do not block the HTTPS SDK script.

keyType.codeContract: The public NEXT_PUBLIC_KAKAO_MAP_APP_KEY is supplied as the Maps JavaScript SDK appkey.
keyType.responseInference: The response is domain mismatch rather than invalid-key. Key type cannot be conclusively enumerated without the Kakao owner console; it is not the primary evidenced failure.

domain.format: scheme and exact host only; no path
domain.consolePath: Kakao Developers > My Application > App > Platform Key > JavaScript Key > JavaScript SDK Domains
domain.currentState: NOT_EFFECTIVE: the live Kakao response proves the request origin is not accepted by the appkey used in this deployment.
likelyConfigurationChecks: Confirm the exact origin is saved under the JavaScript key, not Product Link Management.
Confirm the setting belongs to the Kakao app that owns the deployed key.
Confirm https scheme and full preview hostname match exactly, with no path.
Allow Kakao configuration propagation, then repeat the SDK request.
domain.stablePreviewRecommendation: Use an owned non-production staging/preview domain mapped to Vercel Preview. Random Vercel deployment hostnames require repeated allowlist changes; the git-main Vercel alias is production and is not a Preview solution.

fix.requiredAction: Save the exact Preview origin in the JavaScript SDK Domains list for the Kakao app/key used by Vercel Preview.
